project_description: Add one feature-owned coding-agent session classification behind a bounded public SDK contract and one exclusive metadata-only extension plane. Classification runs after authoritative session/A-leg binding and the secret guard, projects into SessionView before later request stages, preserves large-payload wire-path eligibility with bounded proof facts, and keeps optional TypeSafe/Jev integration behind a fail-open provider-neutral remote-decision adapter. State is keyed only by proxy-owned authority, monotonic (unknown -> coding_agent, never downgraded, never negatively recorded), advisory rather than authorization, and inert for existing features until they explicitly opt in.
